rationale: Technical realization — pass. PLAN-SR-08 and PLAN-DEC-02 select one bounded Plan equivalent: classify task/authority before detailed construction, preserve the complete quality contract and move the full Explicit recording profile into the already mapped governed-plan-authoring reference. Inspection confirms the current parent holds that profile and the reference depends on the parent context procedure. Making the reference self-contained removes that dependency without creating a new resource or runtime operation.

Real constraints — pass. PLAN-SR-01–07 continue to require exact create/revise targets, safe governed signals, current approved initialization with absent work, identity-aware retry and no replacement of existing work. Portable and independently triggered boundary/proof paths remain separate. The three normative assets, metadata/fingerprints, record schema, public operations and supported package transformations are preserved. Missing authority cannot become portable fallback; missing selected guidance stops dependent work.

Approved goals — pass. The unchanged proposal explicitly permits justified retention after complete package assessment. Plan is the concrete reading-order improvement; Design retains a core-first owner/authority and six-step reconciliation procedure with distinct model rules, technical realization, composition, legacy and recording methods. Its overview reminders protect selection and execution points, and architecture-view-examples supplies illustrations and counterexamples rather than another normative method. This is a justified bounded disposition, not silent loss of the two-package assessment or a forced global layout. No separate usage pilot, quota or runtime efficiency claim is added.

Boundaries — pass. The package retains Design authorship, Plan allocation/initialization, independent Assessment, Route coordination, CLI/Records persistence and Engineering package production as separate owners. PLAN-SR-04/05/07 and the runtime view distinguish ordinary save from current approved initialization, stop stale/conflicting basis, and preserve existing work and neighboring evidence on retries. Resource selection precedes dependent operations and late triggers reselect complete methods. No new trust, environment, publication or customer-installation permission is introduced.

Decisions — pass. PLAN-DEC-02 records context, chosen placement, alternatives and consequences at the Plan owner. PLAN-DEC-01 and the separately preserved SKL-DEC-06 narrow initialization decision retain identity and meaning. Skill links this later equivalent explicitly, leaving historical pair-only decisions and approvals scoped to their original subjects. Author material decision evidence cites the unchanged approved direction; no competing ADR or new current authority is created.

Shared contracts and consumers — pass. Skill delegates the Plan equivalent while common functional obligations remain intact. Direct inspection of validate_targeted_recording_profile confirms four selected references, inline fallback and separate trigger lookup; the Plan Design requires complete selected-reference checking and no heading-removal bypass. The plan-surface reader explicitly branches on the inline heading, so its current change.json selection must be reconciled. Installed-placement and normalization readers are in the named impact assessment, with other capabilities protected. Authoring/System, Assessment, Workflow, CLI/Records and package formats retain unchanged interfaces; exact source implementation remains downstream.

Credibility and representative outcomes — pass. The authoring evidence and inspected source establish a feasible existing-resource move, not implemented success. The Plan Design requires portable create/revise, governed create/revise, absent-versus-existing approved work, unknown/invalid authority, late resources, failed/retried persistence and complete installed paths. These distinguish material outcomes and prohibited side effects without an exhaustive test matrix. Missing/wrong/escaped/unmapped/incomplete procedure and unknown values are explicit negative protections. Local and integrated acceptance must expose violations at the resource and actual handoff boundaries; heading checks alone cannot prove semantic preservation.

Preservation and migration — pass. Six coherent obligation groups map scope/inputs, complete recording construction, quality/allocation, three output assets, isolation/initialization/retry and shared policy to specific surviving body/reference owners. No procedure is retired by relocation. Design and all existing assets/specialist resources are retained with an inspected responsibility rationale. Historical records remain original evidence; no format migration, authority transfer, shared-policy rewrite or wider FU-015–018 closeout is selected. A discovered interface change returns to its owner before dependent implementation.

Architecture overview and supporting views — pass. All three complete registered models have concise ownership graphs with external inputs, outputs and meaningful relationships. Skill retains its four necessary views and named child owners; retained Design supplies necessary Context, Building Block and Runtime views and delegates placement to Skill/Packaging. Plan retains necessary Context and Runtime views, adds explicit resource sufficiency before operation, and reasonably declines separate internal-subsystem/deployment diagrams for instruction placement within one method. The overview allocation/output/initialization elements resolve to Delivery allocation, assets, runtime and external Assessment/Records owners. No new service, unowned outcome or competing detailed view is implied.

Actual handoff trace — pass. Design SKILL output provides exact subjects, reconciled requirements/realization/decisions/interactions, assessment basis, local/integrated observation intent and preservation/applicability impacts. Design Review Inputs and Review contract consume those exact owners/examples, direction, decisions and credible acceptance basis. Plan Inputs consumes currently approved model/example subjects and formal review evidence; its quality contract allocates stable requirements, scope, safe dependencies and proof. The unchanged plan and milestone assets carry source artifacts, owning-record pointer, requirements, architecture responsibility, dependencies, validation/evidence/recovery and the separate final review checkpoint. Delivery Review resolves the registered primary plan plus exact approved Design Review ID/member map from scoped context and assesses that allocation. Thus those review identities need not become mutable fields in the plan asset. The Design requires an actual completed-output integrated assessment during delivery; this review establishes contract correspondence, not an executed future authoring result.

Authority, applicability and recording scope — pass. Accepted upstream review ID is proposal-review. Selected full context is complete with no existing findings or blockers. Two observed drifts concern the proposal review's earlier supporting Skill/Plan model hashes, whose assessment_scope explicitly approves only proposal direction. The proposal is unchanged and this draft implements its permitted choices; those historic supporting identities are not retargeted or reused as Design approval. This fresh judgment assesses the three current model identities together and the exact retained source basis. Classification is formal-lifecycle/manual; this first-pass review writes only its own evidence and returns to Route. Saving grants no implementation or automatic downstream permission.
